# Diagram icons

Local renders from the preserved [engineering icon library](../../legacy/docs/icon-libraries/README.md). See its [sources](../../legacy/docs/icon-libraries/sources.json) and [library licence](../../legacy/docs/icon-libraries/EXCALIDRAW-LIBRARIES-LICENSE) for provenance. Artwork identifies the technologies; it does not imply endorsement.

The SVG renderer embeds these PNG glyphs. Boxes, arrows and text remain SVG vectors. Regeneration needs no network or live canvas access.
